title: Little Sophia doll used to map children's brains in Africa

tellings.quote: Yeah. And doll a doll called little Sophia. This ass doll. Like to make him think about STEM.

plain: A doll called Little Sophia, presented as a toy to get children thinking about STEM subjects, was really used to map children's brains in Africa, according to Kurt Metzger, a comedian, who says it on the show as something he passes along rather than saw himself. He mentions it in passing, giving only the doll's name and its stated purpose of encouraging science learning.
